components.gap: Supply Durrett's notation for special cases of the integral (sec. 1.4, pp. 23-24): the integral of f(x) dx for Lebesgue measure on R^d; the integral from a to b of f(x) dx for the integral over E = [a,b]; the integral of f(x) dG(x) for the Stieltjes measure with mu((a,b]) = G(b) - G(a); and the sum over i in Omega of f(i) for counting measure on a countable set, with his remark that results for sums follow from those for integrals. Later route chapters write dx integrals and interval integrals (for example conditional-expectation.tex lines 229-234 and characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments.tex lines 19-40) without a definition, and dG(y) is explained only for probability laws (convolution-gamma-normal.tex lines 102-104).
